title: Surreal Banquet Portal
description: A long dining table covered with a purple bird-patterned tablecloth stretches into a surreal corridor lined with tall white columns and hanging lanterns. Three figures in coats and hats walk away from the viewer toward a glowing red portal, while the sky above dissolves into a swirling galaxy, aurora, and layered torn-paper mountain borders.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a long banquet table with purple tablecloth patterned with colorful birds, set with plates and glasses, extending down a corridor of tall pale columns with hanging lanterns. Three figures wearing coats and hats walk away toward a glowing red circular portal. Above them a swirling galaxy and vibrant aurora borealis break through layered torn paper edges revealing desert mountains and patterned sky, ethereal and dreamlike atmosphere.
